result.note: CPU only. JS includes real queue waits, React and native batch conversion. Decode is zero for native batches; commitBytes is unavailable without a JSON document. Total starts at native pointer-up and ends after scene layout; excludes validation, Android input delivery, UI scheduling, GPU and presentation. Hyperfine additionally includes startup, warm-up, validation and shutdown.
